segments.name: Immuno-oncology
segments.description: Develops T cell-based immunotherapies for hematological malignancies and solid tumors, aimed at patients with cancer.
segments.evidence: The Company's operations are organized and reported as a single reportable segment, which includes all activities related to the discovery, development, and commercialization of its products.

revenueModel.text: Grants and awards from funding entities for research and development, recognized as the Company incurs related expenses.
revenueModel.evidence: Under both accounting frameworks, revenue is recognized when the Company incurs expenses related to the grants for the amount the Company is entitled to under the provisions of the contract.
